localFacts.fact: Lufthansa allows one cabin trolley of max. 55 x 40 x 23 cm and 8 kg: by length the Peak Design (39 cm), LS-224CX (47 cm) and AP-10 (54 cm) fit; the LS-284CX at about 56 cm with the head on does not, unless the head comes off (Leofoto EU: 53 cm pack size).
Ryanair allows a small personal bag of 40 x 30 x 20 cm under the seat in every fare; the GorillaPod 3K Kit (about 23 cm folded) fits, the full-size tripods do not.
Kölner Dom (Domordnung §2): photos without flash for private purposes are allowed, but 'Aufnahmen mit Stativen bedürfen einer Genehmigung durch den Dompropst'; bags only up to 40 x 35 x 15 cm.
Staatliche Museen zu Berlin (Benutzungsordnung): tripods (and bags over 30 x 20 x 10 cm) must be checked in at the cloakroom or put in a locker.

Deutscher Wetterdienst: Windstärke 6 ('starker Wind') is 40 to 45 km/h on the DWD scale, 'Regenschirme sind nur schwer zu halten' - the point where light travel legs with a raised column start to shake.
German terms: Kugelkopf, Schnellwechselplatte, Mittelsäule, Handgriff/Griffverlängerung, Pixel-Shift; Arca-Swiss keeps its name.

localPainPoints.pain: Unsure whether a travel tripod is allowed in cabin baggage on European flights.
localPainPoints.fix: Peak Design (39 cm), LS-224CX (47 cm) and AP-10 (54 cm) fit the Lufthansa 55 x 40 x 23 cm trolley by length; take the head off the LS-284CX or check it in.

quotes.text: Meine Erfahrung bei über 30 Flügen mit Reisestativ im Handgepäck: es gibt so gut wie nie Probleme.

localPainPoints.pain: Light tripods shake on night and long exposures even in light wind.
localPainPoints.fix: Keep the column down, or pick a columnless AP-10 or LS-284CX for pixel shift and ND work (English post).

quotes.text: Nach einigen Nachtaufnahmen habe ich nämlich festgestellt, das dieses Stativ mehr wackelt als mir lieb ist und das schon bei sehr wenig Wind.

localPainPoints.pain: German forum users warn against long centre columns as the way to gain height.
localPainPoints.fix: Two of the five picks have no column at all; on the Peak Design, use the 130 cm column-down height and tilt the Zf's vari-angle screen.

quotes.text: Auf lange, windige Mittelsäulenkonstruktionen würde ich jedenfalls verzichten.

localGain.point: Which of the five fit a Lufthansa 55 x 40 x 23 cm cabin trolley by folded length (and that the LS-284CX needs its head off).
Tripod rules at Kölner Dom (permit from the Dompropst) and the Berlin state museums (cloakroom) before planning a Zf night shot there.
EU codes and maker metric figures for the Leofoto kits (LS-224C: 47 cm, 0,91 kg, 6 kg) and the SmallRig AP-10 (54-133 cm, 1,2 kg, 12 kg).
